turns.question: Q11
turns.text: What is the current status of the website redesign project?

messages.content: What is the current status of the website redesign project?

turns.answer:
The Website Redesign project is **Complete**. 

The project was originally planned for April 20th and shows as complete in the system. The team consisted of:
- Alice (Frontend lead)
- Bob (Backend)
- Erin (QA)

The key milestones were:
- March 1: Content freeze date (later moved to April 6)
- March 8: User testing start date (later moved to April 13)
- March 15: Original launch date (later moved to April 20)

Phase 2 of the redesign hasn't started yet and will have a deadline of October 15th, with Alice handling frontend work and Carol on design.
